input.command:
echo "== homebrew =="; which brew; brew --prefix 2>/dev/null; brew config 2>/dev/null | grep -E "HOMEBREW_VERSION|HOMEBREW_PREFIX|CPU|macOS"; echo "formulae: $(brew list --formula 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')  casks: $(brew list --cask 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; brew list --cask 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo "leaves:"; brew leaves 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; brew tap 2>/dev/null; du -sh /opt/homebrew 2>/dev/null; ls -ld /opt/homebrew; ls ~/Brewfile ~/.Brewfile 2>&1 | head -2
echo; echo "== go =="; which -a go; go version 2>/dev/null; go env GOPATH GOROOT GOMODCACHE 2>/dev/null; ls -d /usr/local/go 2>&1; du -sh ~/go 2>/dev/null
echo; echo "== docker =="; which -a docker docker-compose colima orb orbctl podman 2>/dev/null; docker version --format '{{.Client.Version}} / {{.Server.Version}}' 2>&1 | head -2; docker context ls 2>/dev/null; ls -d /Applications/Docker.app /Applications/OrbStack.app ~/.docker ~/Library/Containers/com.docker.docker ~/.colima ~/.orbstack 2>/dev/null; du -sh ~/Library/Containers/com.docker.docker ~/.docker ~/.orbstack ~/.colima 2>/dev/null; ls /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools 2>/dev/null
echo; echo "== node/npm/global tools =="; which -a node npm pnpm bun volta nvm fnm mise asdf uv pipx 2>/dev/null; node --version 2>/dev/null; npm root -g 2>/dev/null; ls "$(npm root -g 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls -d ~/.nvm ~/.volta ~/.local/share/mise ~/.asdf ~/.bun ~/.cargo ~/.rustup ~/.pyenv ~/.local/bin 2>/dev/null
input.description: Inventory Homebrew, Go, Docker, Node toolchains
